title: Optional UMP and wallet profile continuity semantics

vectors.title: Create and durably retain a profile
vectors.applicability: Mandatory only after explicit selection of ISI-5 ump-profiles; independent of ISI-4 acceptance.
preconditions: Digest-frozen SUT, platform, profile catalog, independent fixture oracle and controlled-service plan.
Isolated funded fixture identities; supported wallet controls and fault boundaries; no personal wallet or public-mainnet spending.
steps: Create a secondary profile through the supported wallet control, then query its published UMP and device state.
Retain the independent projections and raw role-specific evidence; evaluate the complete ISI-5 record.
expected: Creation preserves the selected root, publishes exactly the intended profile inventory and commits a durable snapshot before readiness.
blockers: Native adapter, artifact/platform and controlled-service admission are separate prerequisites to a SUT conformance finding.
